summary: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results (Item 2.02) and the declaration of a quarterly dividend (Item 8.01). The filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, with no mention of any M&A transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program beyond a standard quarterly dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The earnings press release discloses net income of $370.4 million ($10.51 diluted) for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. No special-situation corporate event is presented. The filing is purely an operational update.
